verses.restored: Praise ye YHWH. Blessed is the man that feareth YHWH, that delighteth greatly in his commandments.

familiar.text: Praise ye the LORD. Blessed is the man that feareth the LORD, that delighteth greatly in his commandments.

modern.text: Hallelujah! Blessed is the man who fears the LORD, who greatly delights in His commandments.

modern.text: His descendants will be mighty in the land; the generation of the upright will be blessed.

modern.text: Wealth and riches are in his house, and his righteousness endures forever.

familiar.text: Unto the upright there ariseth light in the darkness: he is gracious, and full of compassion, and righteous.

modern.text: Light dawns in the darkness for the upright— for the gracious, compassionate, and righteous.

modern.text: It is well with the man who is generous and lends freely, whose affairs are guided by justice.

familiar.text: Surely he shall not be moved for ever: the righteous shall be in everlasting remembrance.

modern.text: Surely he will never be shaken; the righteous man will be remembered forever.

familiar.text: He shall not be afraid of evil tidings: his heart is fixed, trusting in the LORD.

modern.text: He does not fear bad news; his heart is steadfast, trusting in the LORD.
